title: Anthropic Expects Mind-Blowing $200 Billion Revenue in 2028 as IPO Looms

Quick Read

  • Anthropic bankers are pricing a $2 trillion IPO off projected 2028 revenue of $200 billion, skipping three years of actual results entirely.

  • Anthropic's revenue surged from $9 billion to $47 billion in just five months, the tenfold annual growth bankers cite to justify trusting the forecast.

  • Both Cerebras and SpaceX, priced on future-growth narratives, fell 40% or more from their post-IPO peaks once quarterly results replaced the excitement.

  • The most widely read finance newsletter on Substack isn't published by a bank, it's Doomberg, where 383,000+ readers get the energy and macro analysis the mainstream press misses. 24/7 Wall St. readers save 17% on their first year here.

The IPO season in 2026 has developed a specialty: pricing companies on results they haven't produced yet. Cerebras Systems (NASDAQ:CBRS) leaned on ramping AI infrastructure demand when it priced its shares. SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) built its $135-a-share debut around a $28.5 trillion addressable-market model that stretched years past its current financials. 

Now Anthropic is testing how far that logic stretches, and it's reportedly planning an October IPO to find out. Bankers are pricing that deal off a 2028 revenue forecast, not this year's results, and not next year's either. That's unusual. Public investors typically price a stock off trailing 12-month numbers, or at most next year's estimate. Reaching three years into the future is a bet that a growth curve holds its current shape for a long time. 

Here are the mind-numbing numbers Anthropic is actually showing investors, and what happened the last two times a mega-IPO tried this same approach.

The Growth Curve Anthropic Is Selling

Anthropic's revenue run rate stood at roughly $9 billion at the end of 2025, then climbed past $47 billion by May, according to company figures. Now, according to two people familiar with its financials cited by Reuters, Anthropic is projecting 2028 revenue of roughly $190 billion to $200 billion -- a figure not previously reported and more than four times the May run rate.

快速阅读

  • 人性化的银行家们将 2 万亿美元的 IPO 定价为 2028 年预计收入 2000 亿美元，完全跳过了三年的实际结果。
  • Anthropic 的收入在短短五个月内从 90 亿美元飙升至 470 亿美元，银行家们用十倍的年度增长来证明对这一预测的信任。
  • Cerebras 和 SpaceX 都以未来增长的叙述为定价，一旦季度业绩取代了兴奋情绪，它们就比 IPO 后的峰值下跌了 40% 或更多。
  • Substack 上阅读最广泛的金融新闻通讯不是由银行出版的，而是《Doomberg》，超过 383,000 名读者在这里获得了主流媒体错过的活力和宏观分析。 24/7 Wall St. 读者第一年可节省 17%。

2026 年的 IPO 季节形成了一个特点：根据公司尚未产生的业绩对其进行定价。 Cerebras Systems（纳斯达克股票代码：CBRS）在定价时依赖于不断增长的人工智能基础设施需求。 SpaceX（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）以每股 135 美元的价格首次亮相，围绕着 28.5 万亿美元的目标市场模型，该模型的规模超出了其当前的财务状况数年。

现在，Anthropic 正在测试这种逻辑能延伸到什么程度，据报道，它计划在 10 月份进行首次公开​​募股来找出答案。 银行家的定价基于 2028 年的收入预测，而不是今年的业绩，也不是明年的业绩。 这很不寻常。 公众投资者通常根据过去 12 个月的数据或最多明年的估计来定价股票。 未来三年是增长曲线长期保持当前形状的赌注。

以下是 Anthropic 实际向投资者展示的令人头脑麻木的数字，以及最近两次大型 IPO 尝试采用相同方法时发生的情况。

Anthropic 正在销售的增长曲线

根据公司数据，截至 2025 年底，Anthropic 的收入运行率约为 90 亿美元，到 5 月份则攀升至 470 亿美元以上。 现在，据路透社援引两位熟悉其财务状况的人士透露，Anthropic 预计 2028 年的收入约为 1900 亿至 2000 亿美元——这一数字此前未曾报道过，是 5 月份运行率的四倍多。
